newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Bosnia mediator Carl Bildt leaves hospital.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia mediator Carl Bildt leaves hospital.

text.p: Swedish politician Carl Bildt, who is overseeing international peace efforts in Bosnia, was released from a Stockholm hospital on Friday after suffering severe influenza.

Bildt, 47, was admitted to hospital six days ago after collapsing at home. It was not known when the leader of Sweden's opposition conservative party, the Moderates, and former prime minister, would return to his Sarajevo office.

Bildt has said he will give up his position as High Representative in Bosnia this year, probably around April or May, and return to Sweden to lead the Moderates into the next general election in September 1998.
